# NovaPanel v1.6.144

- Separate remote inbound creation from configuration templates. Select a local protocol prototype, target servers, per-server ports, and each target's own TLS profile; every target is preflighted before any inbound is created.
- Name each created inbound with its target server name; duplicate server display names receive a stable ID suffix. Protocol settings, including fixed protocol passwords/keys, are copied, but user bindings are not; bind users on each target after creation.
- Require target-owned TLS profiles for TLS-required protocols, reject reuse of the same certificate across selected targets, and generate a separate ECDSA identity for each MASQUE target.
- Preflight checks the target's actual TCP/UDP bind availability as well as the saved/core configuration before any server in the batch is changed.
- Restore configuration-template inbound merging by the original tag. Matching inbounds merge/update without automatic renaming or history/rule-reference migration; unrelated target inbounds are not deleted.
- Aggregate nodes and aggregate subscriptions are unchanged.
